text: って　だんなが　つりに　いったん　だけど…　しんじて　いいのかねえ

structure.jp: って　だんなが　つりに　いったん　だけど…
structure.en: ...said my husband, and off he went fishing, but...

structure.jp: しんじて　いいのかねえ
structure.en: I wonder if I can believe him

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, which shows that the words before it were said by someone. Here it points back to the line just before. って　だんなが = 'so said my husband'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after an activity, followed by 'go', means 'go to do that activity'. つりに　いった = 'went fishing'.

patterns.name: 〜ていい
patterns.explanation: ていい after a verb means 'it's okay to do it'. しんじて　いい = 'okay to believe'.
